# sfmemo

> Memory for AI.

sfmemo is building HBM chips in California for GPUs and AI accelerators.

Canonical website: https://sfmemo.com/
Contact: root@sfmemo.com

## Current work

- sfmemo's proprietary Verilog chip designs are being used by leading U.S. frontier AI labs to design the next generation of American AI chips.

## Objective

- Our objective is to manufacture HBM chips in California using US based fabs operating advanced X-ray lithography machines.

## Primary source

- https://sfmemo.com/
